text:
rachel: heads-up — ran into a pretty annoying repro when trying to use the JS SDK inside a pnpm workspace app that builds for edge (vite -> webworker). dev server ok, but the preview/prod worker crashes with `ReferenceError: require is not defined` or sometimes `TypeError: RedwoodClient is not a constructor`.

rachel: unique twist: this only happens when the app is in a pnpm workspace with hoisted deps. Consumer is using pnpm v7, node linker=hoisted. If I `npm pack` the SDK and install the tar directly outside workspace the error disappears.

dan: oh interesting — hoisting + optimizeDeps can make vite/rollup resolve a different copy of the package (or resolve package.json conditions differently). do you have the package.json `exports` shape for the SDK?

omari: also check the built ESM artifact for any cjs traces. even a small leftover `require(` in a bundled ESM file can make bundlers treat it as CJS in certain resolution paths.

rachel: SDK package.json has `main/module/types` and an `exports` conditional: import -> `./dist/index.esm.mjs`, require -> `./dist/index.cjs.js`. The pnpm-hoisted resolution produces a flattened node_modules tree such that Vite's optimizeDeps resolves package.json to the workspace root and picks the require branch for the worker build.

dan: repro steps I used to reproduce locally:
1) pnpm init -w, create workspace with `app/` and `packages/sdk`
2) `pnpm -w install`, `pnpm -w build` for sdk -> emits cjs+esm
3) in app, `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js'`, vite config: `build.target='es2020', worker: true`
4) `pnpm --filter app dev` -> dev ok, `pnpm --filter app build && pnpm --filter app preview` -> worker console shows `ReferenceError: require is not defined`

omari: small experiment: setting `optimizeDeps.include=['redwood-inference-js']` in vite fixed dev server prebundle, but the preview build still resolved to the cjs entry unless I also set `resolve.mainFields=['module','browser','main']` in the rollup build.

dan: that's consistent: optimizeDeps touches only dev-time esbuild prebundle. For build-time rollup resolution, exports conditional + pnpm hoisting can drive different results. One workaround: add `exports."./browser"` or `browser` field pointing at the esm bundle so bundlers prefer it for browser/worker targets.

rachel: another oddity: when I switched the SDK publish to include an explicit `dist/edge.mjs` (tiny file that `export * from './index.esm.mjs'; export { default } from './index.esm.mjs'`) and added `exports."./edge" -> ./dist/edge.mjs`, the app builds worked even in the pnpm workspace — but only if the consumer imports `redwood-inference-js/edge`. Without that consumer change, some builds still pick the cjs path.

omari: action items for SDK repo we agreed on:
- Add a `browser` field and `exports."./browser"` that point to ESM browser/edge bundle.
- Ensure published ESM files contain no `require`/`module.exports` remnants. Add a dist-lint step that greps for `\brequire\(|module\.|exports\.` and fails publish.
- Offer an `./edge` export (shim) as a short-term compatibility entry.
- Add a CI pack-and-smoke job: pnpm pack the SDK, install into minimal consumer templates (vite worker, webpack worker) using pnpm workspace layout to reproduce hoisting cases, run built worker in miniflare and fail on `require is not defined` or constructor/default-import errors.

dan: docs note: add a DevEx page describing pnpm/hoisting caveat + recommended consumer settings: `optimizeDeps.include`, `build.rollupOptions.resolve.mainFields=['module','browser','main']`, or import `redwood-inference-js/edge` until patched.

ci-bot: nightly/sdk-hoist-matrix: failed on pnpm-hoisted/vite-worker entry with `ReferenceError: require is not defined` — logs attached to ticket #SDK-4812.

docsb: i've added a short internal snippet to the DevEx guide about pnpm hoisting + exports resolution and linked the SDK issue. will update once SDK publishes an edge entry.

rachel: thanks — filing the SDK issue now with the private repro link and configs. happy to test candidate releases. :seedling:
